proposals.before: In the first year of Guangda he was appointed director of the personnel bureau in the Ministry of Works.
proposals.after: In the first year of Guangda he was appointed director of the personnel bureau in the Department of State Affairs.
proposals.reason: 尚書吏部郎 is a personnel post in the Department of State Affairs (尚書), not the Ministry of Works.

proposals.before: In the first year of Guangda he was appointed Director of the Personnel Bureau in the Ministry of Works.
proposals.after: In the first year of Guangda he was appointed Director of the Personnel Bureau in the Department of State Affairs.
proposals.reason: Same office mistranslation: 吏部 belongs to 尚書省, not Works.

proposals.before: Before long he was appointed right vice director of the ministry of works; before he could assume the post he was additionally made palace attendant and transferred to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.
proposals.after: Before long he was appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs; before he could assume the post he was additionally made palace attendant and transferred to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.
proposals.reason: 尚書右僕射 is vice director of the Department of State Affairs, not Ministry of Works.

proposals.before: He was appointed director in the personnel bureau of the ministry of works; his post as commandant of footsoldiers remained unchanged, and he continued to attend the eastern palace.
proposals.after: He was appointed director in the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs; his post as commandant of footsoldiers remained unchanged, and he continued to attend the eastern palace.
proposals.reason: 尚書吏部郎中 is not Ministry of Works.

proposals.before: He was transferred to right vice director of the ministry of works and soon to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.
proposals.after: He was transferred to right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and soon to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.
proposals.reason: 尚書僕射 is Department of State Affairs.

decisions.reason: 尚書吏部郎 is a personnel directorate under the Department of State Affairs (尚書省); Ministry of Works would be 工部, which the Chinese does not support.
Same unit: 尚書吏部郎 belongs to 尚書省 (Department of State Affairs), not the Ministry of Works.
尚書右僕射 (and the following 左僕射) are vice directors of the Department of State Affairs; Ministry of Works is unsupported.
尚書吏部郎中 is personnel bureau director under the Department of State Affairs, not the Ministry of Works.
尚書右僕射 / 左僕射 are Department of State Affairs vice directors; the English Ministry of Works misreads 尚書.
